_comment: Tile Palette — reusable tile types used to paint maps. Each tile carries: `id` (the cell reference), display `name`, `tag` (string used to group tiles in the editor palette panel — empty for untagged), `sprite` (path under /sprites/map/), and the behavioral attributes — `walkable` (blocks movement when false), `obstructs` (blocks light + ranged line-of-sight when true), `locked` (gates passage/interaction until unlocked), `light_source` (the tile emits light), `light_range` (light radius in cells), `animation` (visual effect — "none" | "torch" | "fire" | "fairy" | "smoke"), `counter` (id from counters.json — empty for none), `encounter` (id from encounters.json — empty for none; the encounter sprite renders as an overlay), and `spawn` (id from spawns.json — empty for none). Optional `link` is a one-way portal: `{ "map_id": "<target>", "x": <col>, "y": <row> }`. Map cells are full copies of palette entries; palette edits don't auto-propagate to painted cells.
